mapper.select: SELECT cfg.module_code AS moduleCode, cfg.module_name AS moduleName, cfg.dim_code AS dimCode, cfg.dim_name AS dimName FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth_cfg cfg WHERE cfg.module_code = 'ssm_row' AND cfg.dim_code = 'ssm_dim_bizline' AND cfg.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.owner_id AS userName, e.DEPT_ID AS deptId, t.item_value AS itemValue FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t INNER JOIN bi_portal.hr_employee e ON e.USER_NAME = t.owner_id AND e.IS_ACTIVE = 1 WHERE t.owner_type = 'User' AND t.module_code = 'ssm_row' AND t.dim_code = 'ssm_dim_bizline' AND t.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * t.active_duration_days DAY)
mapper.insert:
